name: Spectral Captain
description: A ghostly commander leading their troops beyond death.

abilities.name: Ghost
abilities.description: The Captain has resistance to physical damage. Mark a Stress to move up to Close range through solid objects.

abilities.name: Unending Battle
abilities.description: Spend 2 Fear to return up to 1d4+1 defeated Spectral allies to the battle at the points where they first appeared (with no marked HP or Stress).

abilities.name: Hold Fast
abilities.description: When the Captain’s Spectral allies are forced to make a reaction roll, you can mark a Stress to give those allies a +2 bonus to the roll.

abilities.name: Momentum
abilities.description: When the Captain makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.
